objects_reviewed: Actual native TrivSqZeroExt Q(Q^2), augmentation, native DirectSum decomposition, connected grading and GradedAlgebra instances; two genuine degree1 generators.
Actual FreeAlgebra Q(Fin2) and RingQuot by the four ordered quadratic monomials, with mutually inverse native algebra maps giving the presented algebra equivalence.
All-degree free native modules on genuine binary words, actual A-linear differentials and augmentation, full kernel=image proofs, native ChainComplex and ProjectiveResolution.

Actual shifted module gradings, homogeneous maps, degree-n free bases and degree1 entries; image equals the native positive-degree radical action, giving a genuine minimal linear resolution in every degree with nu_2(n)=n.

Actual Hom(P_n,Q), zero precomposition differential from epsilon action, and Q-linear coordinate equivalences; native Ext comparison with injectivity, surjectivity and linearity, including actual Ext0.

Native Ext Q-module finite in every degree with finrank derived as2^n; actual Yoneda composition is present. Hilbert series uses native graded Ext spaces and does not require a separately bundled total Yoneda ring.
Actual native formal Hilbert power series from those Ext finranks and proved identity (1-2X)H=1.
Every finite positive-degree family, including repetitions and empty family, has D(1/2) nonzero. Polynomial-to-series injectivity turns D*H=P into (1-2X)P=D and evaluation at1/2 contradicts it.
scope_limits: Only the finite polynomial cyclotomic-denominator conjunct in the printed source is refuted, using the admissible ordinary N=2 case; the printed product has no explicit index set and this interpretation is prominent in report, README and PR body.

The example Hilbert series1/(1-2t) is rational, so rationality itself is not refuted. No claim excludes arbitrary infinite formal Euler products or a corrected conjecture with additional restrictions.

All necessary grading, exactness, minimality, native Ext and Hilbert comparison bridges are proved in Lean. Primary references justify conventional terminology and normalization, without added Lean axioms.
